abort.already_configured: Device Lifecycle is already configured. Add new purchases or runtime tracking from the existing integration.

user.title: Add purchase
user.description: Select all physical devices belonging to the same purchase and enter the shared data only once. Device Lifecycle creates a persistent Asset identity for each physical device.

data_description.device_ids: Select one or more physical Home Assistant devices. A device can belong to only one active purchase. Filtering is deliberately conservative, so ambiguous devices remain visible.
data_description.warranty_type: 1 and 2 year warranties are calculated automatically from the purchase date. Use Manual only for another end date.
data_description.purchase_price: Total purchase price, not per-device price. The configured Home Assistant currency is stored with the purchase.
data_description.receipt_url: Optional URL to a receipt, invoice or other purchase document.
data_description.installed_date: Leave empty to use the purchase date as the installation date for a new purchase. You can change it later.

reconfigure.title: Edit purchase
reconfigure.description: Edit purchase data or the devices included in it. Removing a device from the purchase removes its Lifecycle entity from this purchase but keeps its persistent Asset identity.

data_description.device_ids: Add or remove physical devices belonging to this purchase. Obvious system/software devices are filtered, while ambiguous devices remain visible.
data_description.warranty_type: 1 and 2 year warranties are calculated automatically from the purchase date. Manual uses the date below.
data_description.purchase_price: Total purchase price, not per-device price. The purchase keeps the currency captured when it was created.
data_description.receipt_url: Optional URL to a receipt, invoice or other purchase document.
data_description.installed_date: The installation date can be changed or cleared independently of the purchase date.

error.device_missing: One of the selected devices no longer exists in Home Assistant.
error.already_tracked: One or more selected devices already belongs to another lifecycle purchase.
error.purchase_date_required_for_warranty: A 1 or 2 year warranty requires a purchase date.
error.manual_warranty_date_required: Enter a manual warranty end date.
error.invalid_purchase_date: The purchase date could not be parsed.
error.invalid_purchase_price: The total purchase price must be zero or greater.
error.service_device_not_allowed: The selected item is a Home Assistant service rather than a physical device.

user.title: Add runtime tracking
user.description: First choose the physical device and runtime detection method. Next, select a source entity suitable for that method.

data_description.device_id: The Runtime hours sensor is linked to this physical Home Assistant device and its persistent Device Lifecycle Asset. Service-type HA devices are rejected.
data_description.runtime_mode: Choose whether runtime is detected from an entity being on or from measured power.

runtime_source.title: Configure runtime source
runtime_source.description: The source list is filtered for the selected tracking method. Power mode shows only actual power sensors; on-state mode shows sensible on/off entities.

data_description.source_entity_id: Power mode accepts Power device-class sensors whose unit can be converted to watts. On-state mode accepts switches, lights, binary sensors, input booleans and fans. Device Lifecycle's own entities are excluded.
data_description.power_threshold: Runtime starts when the source power, normalized to watts, rises above this threshold.
data_description.power_hysteresis: Prevents toggling around the threshold. Example: 10 W threshold and 2 W hysteresis starts above 10 W and stops below 8 W. Must be between 0 and the threshold.

reconfigure.title: Edit runtime tracking
reconfigure.description: Choose the runtime detection method. Next, select a source entity suitable for that method. The tracked physical device is unchanged.

data_description.runtime_mode: Choose whether runtime is detected from an entity being on or from measured power.

reconfigure_source.title: Configure runtime source
reconfigure_source.description: The source list is filtered for the selected tracking method. Power threshold and hysteresis are shown only in power mode.

data_description.source_entity_id: Select a source suitable for the chosen mode. Device Lifecycle's own entities are excluded.
data_description.power_threshold: Runtime starts when the source power, normalized to watts, rises above this threshold.
data_description.power_hysteresis: Example: 10 W threshold and 2 W hysteresis stops only below 8 W. Existing trackers default to 0 W hysteresis, preserving old behavior.

error.device_missing: The selected physical device no longer exists in Home Assistant.
error.runtime_already_tracked: This device already has runtime tracking.
error.source_missing: The selected source entity is not currently available in Home Assistant.
error.invalid_power_source: Power tracking requires a Power device-class sensor with a Home Assistant-supported power unit.
error.invalid_on_state_source: On-state tracking requires a supported on/off entity.
error.power_threshold_required: Enter a power threshold for Power mode.
error.invalid_power_threshold: The power threshold must be zero or greater.
error.invalid_power_hysteresis: The hysteresis must be zero or greater.
error.power_hysteresis_too_large: The hysteresis cannot be greater than the power threshold.
error.invalid_runtime_mode: The runtime tracking method is invalid.
error.service_device_not_allowed: The selected item is a Home Assistant service rather than a trackable physical device.

create_entry.asset_ha_relationship_updated: The Home Assistant relationship for {asset_id} — {asset_name} was updated.
create_entry.asset_purchase_updated: The Purchase relationship for {asset_id} — {asset_name} was updated.

error.asset_missing: The selected Asset no longer exists.
error.asset_store_error: The Asset Store rejected or could not save the change. No replacement Asset was created.
error.device_already_linked: The selected device is already the primary relationship of Asset {owner_asset_id}.
error.device_lifecycle_device_not_allowed: A Device Lifecycle-owned device cannot be linked as an external relationship.
error.device_missing: The selected Home Assistant device is missing or unavailable.
error.ha_device_purchase_dependency: The current device is used by an active Purchase. Remove that dependency before unlinking or replacing it.
error.ha_device_runtime_dependency: The current device is used by active Runtime tracking. Remove that dependency before unlinking or replacing it.
error.ha_relationship_changed: The primary Home Assistant relationship changed while this form was open. Review the current relationship and try again.
error.invalid_area: Select an existing Home Assistant Area, or explicitly clear the current Area.
error.invalid_deployment_state: The selected deployment state is invalid.
error.invalid_ha_relationship_action: Select a valid Home Assistant relationship action.
error.invalid_purchase: The selected Purchase is not available for a new relationship.
error.no_assets: There are no Assets to manage yet.
error.non_physical_device_not_allowed: The selected Home Assistant device belongs to an excluded non-physical integration.
error.purchase_conflict: The Purchase relationship conflicts with existing Asset Store ownership.
error.service_device_not_allowed: The selected item is a Home Assistant service rather than a physical device.

asset_deployment.description: Asset: {asset}. Current Area: {current_area}. Values are changed only when explicitly selected; use the clear controls to remove a date or Area. A stale Area ID remains stored until you repair it.
asset_deployment.title: Deployment

change_asset_purchase.description: Asset: {asset}. Current relationship: {current_purchase}. Historical Purchases are shown only when already related to this Asset; choose one of the currently configured Purchases or No Purchase to replace it explicitly.
change_asset_purchase.title: Change Purchase relationship

create_manual_asset.description: Create a physical Asset without requiring a Home Assistant device. UUID and DL ID are generated automatically and cannot be edited.
create_manual_asset.title: Create manual Asset

confirm_not_deployed.description: Changing {asset} to Not deployed will clear its current deployment Area: {current_area}. The installation date will be preserved unless you explicitly changed or cleared it on the previous form.
confirm_not_deployed.title: Clear deployment Area?

edit_asset_metadata.description: Edit physical metadata for {asset}. Asset UUID, DL ID, deployment, warranty and Home Assistant relationships are not editable here.
edit_asset_metadata.title: Edit Asset metadata

ha_relationship.description: Asset: {asset}. Current primary relationship: {current_device}. Linking changes only Asset Store references; the external device is not claimed, renamed, moved, or modified.
ha_relationship.title: Home Assistant relationship

manage_asset.description: Select an Asset by its persistent DL ID and display name.
manage_asset.title: Manage Asset
